# BTC500

> Free Bitcoin halving countdown, cycle score, and investment tools built around the BTC500 strategy: buy exactly 500 days before each Bitcoin halving and sell exactly 500 days after.

Site: https://btc500.net
Contact: btc500halving@gmail.com
X/Twitter: https://x.com/btc500halving
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/btc500halving

## What is BTC500?

BTC500 is a simple, rules-based Bitcoin investment approach timed to the ~4-year halving cycle:

1. Buy Bitcoin exactly 500 days before the next halving.
2. Hold through the halving.
3. Sell exactly 500 days after the halving.
4. Repeat each ~4-year cycle.

The site is free educational software with live countdowns, backtesting tools, on-chain indicators, and market data dashboards. Nothing on the site is financial advice.

## Key facts

- Next Bitcoin halving: projected for around April 2028, when block height reaches 1,050,000. Exact date depends on Bitcoin's average block time.
- Historical halvings:
  - 2012-11-28 — block 210,000
  - 2016-07-09 — block 420,000
  - 2020-05-11 — block 630,000
  - 2024-04-20 — block 840,000
- Halving frequency: every 210,000 blocks (~4 years); the block reward paid to miners is cut in half.
- BTC500 buy window: exactly 500 days before each halving.
- BTC500 sell window: exactly 500 days after each halving.
- The strategy has been profitable in every completed cycle (2012, 2016, 2020) based on historical Bitstamp prices. Past performance does not guarantee future results.

## FAQ

- What is the BTC500 strategy? Buy Bitcoin exactly 500 days before each halving and sell exactly 500 days after. This rules-based method captures historically strong parts of Bitcoin's ~4-year halving cycle without day-trading.
- When is the next Bitcoin halving? Projected for around April 2028 at block height 1,050,000. Exact date depends on average block time.
- How does the halving work? Every 210,000 blocks (~4 years) the block reward is cut in half, reducing new supply. Lower issuance has historically coincided with multi-year price cycles.
- Has the strategy been profitable? In every completed cycle (2012, 2016, 2020) buying 500 days before and selling 500 days after has been profitable. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
- Is BTC500 free? Yes. Countdown, simulator, timeline, dashboards, articles, and embed widgets are free with no account required.
- Is this financial advice? No. BTC500 is educational software and market data tooling.
